# Installing packages and loading libraries

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

install.packages("xfun")

library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(UpSetR)
```

## Define settings

In this section filters are added to remove noise from the dataset. By
doing so, it can be prevented that 'low counts' are indicating
false-positive results. Only genes with FDR ≤0,01 are counted as
differentially expressed.

```{r}
# FDR-cutoff and making outputmap
fdr_cutoff <- 0.01         
min_count <- 10            
in_samples_expr <- 3    

# Making outputmap for saving results in file
outdir <- "DEG_results"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Preparing metadata and countdata

```{r}
# Raw counts
counts_raw_eq <- read.table("20250707_Equ03_174libs_readcounts.txt",
                            header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

# Sample metadata
coldata_eq <- read.table("20250707_Equ03_174libs_samples.txt",
                         header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
```

## Defining and matching columns

In this section columnnames of counts are matched to the rownames of
metadata. Factors are important for correctly calculating DESeq
contrasts.

```{r}
# Remove (X) from column names
colnames(counts_raw_eq) <- gsub("^X", "", colnames(counts_raw_eq))

# Check if column names match now, if (true) then it matches
all(rownames(coldata_eq) == colnames(counts_raw_eq))  

# Print differences, if there is no difference, nothing will be printed
setdiff(rownames(coldata_eq), colnames(counts_raw_eq))
setdiff(colnames(counts_raw_eq), rownames(coldata_eq))

# Use raw counts as variable
counts <- counts_raw_eq

# Put factors in metadata
coldata_eq$Group <- factor(coldata_eq$Group, levels = c("AL","AE","SE","TE","TL"))
coldata_eq$Tissue <- factor(coldata_eq$Tissue)
coldata_eq$Sex <- factor(coldata_eq$Sex)
```

## Define groups in dataset

In this section groups and tissues are defined for further analysis:

1.  **Torpor groups**

*SE = Baseline vs (AE+AL+TE+TL) = Hibernation*

**Why?**

To compare which genes are specifically expressed during hibernation vs
baseline (SE).

2.  **Temperature groups**

For defining temperature-specific genes between warm and cold samples.

*a. SE = Warm (baseline euthermic state)*

*b. TE + TL = Cold (torpor with low body temperature)*

**Why?**

To identify cold-induced genes without carry-over effects from arousal
phases. By comparing SE vs (TE+TL), we avoid transcript carry-over from
AE/AL phases.

```{r}
# Torpor analysis: SE = Baseline vs (AE+AL+TE+TL) = Hibernation
grouping_torpor <- setNames(
  ifelse(coldata_eq$Group == "SE", "Baseline", "Hibernation"), 
  rownames(coldata_eq)
)

# Temperature analysis: SE = Warm vs (TE+TL) = Cold
grouping_temp <- setNames(
  ifelse(coldata_eq$Group %in% c("TE", "TL"), "Cold", 
         ifelse(coldata_eq$Group == "SE", "Warm", NA)),
  rownames(coldata_eq)
)
```

## Select tissues

In this section tissues that have SE-samples will be selected. SE can be
defined as a baseline. BAT and WAT don't contain SE samples, therefore
they will be excluded for the next steps (for now)

```{r}
# All tissues
all_tissues <- sort(unique(coldata_eq$Tissue))

# Select tissues that have SE (baseline)
tissues_with_SE <- sort(unique(coldata_eq$Tissue[coldata_eq$Group == "SE"]))
```

BAT and WAT are present in all_tissues, but not in tissues_with_SE,
since they do not contain any SE-samples.

## DGE per tissue

```{r}
run_deseq_tissue <- function(tissue_name, grouping_vector, group_levels, prefix) {
  
# Collecting all samples for one tissue
  samp_idx <- which(coldata_eq$Tissue == tissue_name)
  meta_t <- coldata_eq[samp_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  counts_t <- counts[, rownames(meta_t), drop = FALSE]
  
# Add grouping factor before filtering step
  meta_t$Group2 <- grouping_vector[rownames(meta_t)]
  
# AL/AE samples were excluded from the temperature analysis and assigned 'NA'.
# This filtering step keeps only relevant samples (Warm vs Cold) for comparing the two stages.
  valid_idx <- !is.na(meta_t$Group2)
  meta_t <- meta_t[valid_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  counts_t <- counts_t[, rownames(meta_t), drop = FALSE]
  
# Check if we have samples in both groups
  group_counts <- table(meta_t$Group2)
  if(length(group_counts) < 2) {
    cat("  WARNING: Tissue", tissue_name, "doesn't have samples in both groups. Skipping.\n")
    return(character(0))
  }
  
# Keep genes with sufficient counts in enough samples to reduce noise
  keep <- rowSums(counts_t >= min_count) >= in_samples_expr
  counts_t <- counts_t[keep, ]
  
# Convert to factor with correct levels
  meta_t$Group2 <- factor(meta_t$Group2, levels = group_levels)
  
# DESeq DGE analysis
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_t, colData = meta_t, design = ~ Group2)
  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
  
# Yield results (p-adj / FDR usage)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Group2", group_levels[1], group_levels[2]), alpha = fdr_cutoff)
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("Gene_ID") %>% 
    mutate(Tissue = tissue_name) %>% 
    arrange(padj)
  
# Save all genes
  write.csv(res_df, file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", tissue_name, "_all.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  
# Filter significant genes (FDR ≤ 0.01)
  sig <- res_df %>% filter(!is.na(padj) & padj <= fdr_cutoff)
  write.csv(sig, file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", tissue_name, "_sig.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  

# Return list of significant Gene_IDs
  return(sig$Gene_ID)
}
```

## DGE between SE vs ALL (Baseline vs Hibernation)

Only for 7 tissues WITH SE samples.

```{r}
torpor_genes <- list()

# Loop over tissues with SE-samples only
for(tissue in tissues_with_SE){
  cat("Running Torpor DGE for tissue:", tissue, "\n")
  torpor_genes[[tissue]] <- run_deseq_tissue(
    tissue_name = tissue,
    grouping_vector = grouping_torpor,
    group_levels = c("Baseline","Hibernation"),
    prefix = "Torpor"
  )
}
```

## Temperature DGE-analysis: SE vs (TE+TL)

Only for 7 tissues WITH SE samples

```{r}
temp_genes <- list()

# Loop over tissues with SE
for(tissue in all_tissues){
  cat("Running Temperature DGE for tissue:", tissue, "\n")
  temp_genes[[tissue]] <- run_deseq_tissue(
    tissue_name = tissue,
    grouping_vector = grouping_temp,
    group_levels = c("Cold","Warm"),
    prefix = "Temperature"
  )
}

# Summary
cat("\n=== TEMPERATURE ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
for(tissue in names(temp_genes)){
  cat(tissue, ":", length(temp_genes[[tissue]]), "DEGs\n")
}
```

## UpSet plot for TORPOR analysis

```{r}
library(UpSetR)

# Define genes
all_genes <- rownames(counts)

# Dataframe for UpSet, only for tissues with SE samples
torpor_upset_df <- lapply(torpor_genes, function(genes) {
  if (is.null(genes) || length(genes) == 0) genes <- character(0)
  setNames(as.integer(all_genes %in% genes), all_genes)
}) %>%
  do.call(cbind, .) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Add column names
colnames(torpor_upset_df) <- names(torpor_genes)

# UpSet plot
upset(
  torpor_upset_df, 
  nsets = length(torpor_genes), 
  order.by = "freq", 
  main.bar.color = "steelblue", 
  sets.bar.color = "grey40",
  mainbar.y.label = "Intersection Size (Torpor DEGs)",
  sets.x.label = "DEGs per Tissue",
  text.scale = 1.5
)
```

## Export summary tables

```{r}
# Torpor summary
torpor_summary <- data.frame(
  Tissue = names(torpor_genes),
  N_DEGs = sapply(torpor_genes, length)
) %>% arrange(desc(N_DEGs))

write.csv(torpor_summary, file.path(outdir, "Torpor_DEG_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Temperature summary
temp_summary <- data.frame(
  Tissue = names(temp_genes),
  N_DEGs = sapply(temp_genes, length)
) %>% arrange(desc(N_DEGs))

write.csv(temp_summary, file.path(outdir, "Temperature_DEG_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## PCA analysis

### All tissues

```{r}
# VST transformation
dds_all <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts,
colData = coldata_eq,
design = ~ Group)
vst_all <- vst(dds_all, blind = TRUE)

# PCA
pca_all <- prcomp(t(assay(vst_all)))
percentVar <- round(100 * (pca_all$sdev^2 / sum(pca_all$sdev^2)), 1)

# Plotting
ggplot(data.frame(PC1 = pca_all$x[,1], PC2 = pca_all$x[,2], Tissue = coldata_eq$Tissue),
aes(PC1, PC2, color = Tissue)) +
geom_point(size = 3) +
xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "%")) +
ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "%")) +
theme_bw()

```

![](images/clipboard-1404968234.png)

Tissue (PC1) explains most of the variance in the samples, PC2
(hibernation phase) explains the second most variance. Other PC's could
be sex, individual differences, age, random noise, etc.

### Every tissue individually 

```{r}
for(tissue in all_tissues){
idx <- coldata_eq$Tissue == tissue
dds_t <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts[, idx],
colData = coldata_eq[idx, ],
design = ~ Group)
vst_t <- vst(dds_t, blind = TRUE)
pca_t <- prcomp(t(assay(vst_t)))
percentVar_t <- round(100 * (pca_t$sdev^2 / sum(pca_t$sdev^2)), 1)

ggplot(data.frame(PC1 = pca_t$x[,1], PC2 = pca_t$x[,2], Group = coldata_eq$Group[idx]),
aes(PC1, PC2, color = Group)) +
geom_point(size = 3) +
xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar_t[1], "%")) +
ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar_t[2], "%")) +
theme_bw() +
ggtitle(tissue) -> p
print(p)
}

```
